property_summary: When an admissible call to Collect completes successfully and the caller's pre-existing recorded balance is >= MinSum and >= the requested amount, the caller's recorded balance must be reduced by exactly the requested amount; the buggy version leaves the balance unchanged because it inverts the success flag, so this rule is violated for some input.
change_summary: Make the balance update depend on the failed-call flag by negating _s, so a successful ETH send results in reverted accounting semantics.
